sanctuary_sites: CNS (higher relapse risk than GCB in some clinical/genetic subsets; CNS prophylaxis may be considered based on overall CNS-IPI and site/genetic risk rather than COO alone)

biomarkers.name: Hans algorithm (ABC = CD10-/BCL6-/MUM1+ or CD10-/BCL6+/MUM1+; non-GCB by Hans is an IHC surrogate and not identical to GEP-defined ABC)
biomarkers.prevalence: ~30-40% by gene-expression profiling; non-GCB by Hans IHC is more common and not equivalent
biomarkers.clinical_use: Cell-of-origin assignment by IHC is an imperfect surrogate for GEP. Historically ABC/non-GCB had worse outcomes than GCB with R-CHOP, though treatment advances may lessen this difference

biomarkers.name: MYD88 L265P
biomarkers.clinical_use: Activates TLR-MYD88-NF-baB signalling and is enriched in the MCD/C5 subtype, often with CD79B mutation. Associated with sensitivity signals to BTK-pathway targeting in some studies, but not a validated stand-alone predictive biomarker in routine practice

biomarkers.name: CD79B
biomarkers.clinical_use: B-cell receptor signalling activation; often co-occurs with MYD88 in MCD/C5 cluster. May mark BTK-dependent biology, but routine clinical prediction of ibrutinib benefit is not established

biomarkers.name: LymphGen molecular classification (MCD, BN2, N1, EZB, ST2, A53)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Refines biology beyond COO. MCD (often MYD88+CD79B) and N1 are enriched in ABC; EZB is enriched in GCB. Prognostic and biologically informative, with emerging therapeutic implications in clinical trials, but not yet standard-of-care treatment selection in most settings

biomarkers.name: Same treatment biomarker suite as DLBCL_GCB (CD20, CD19, CD22, CD79b, polatuzumab, CAR-T)

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Diffuse infiltrate of large B lymphocytes morphologically overlapping with GCB DLBCL; distinction is best made by gene expression profiling, with IHC algorithms such as Hans used as imperfect surrogates
variants: plasmacytoid features (in some tumours, including some MCD/C5 cases)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Not morphologically graded; molecular subtypes/clusters (eg, MCD, N1, BN2) provide biologic and prognostic stratification

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Constitutive NF-baB pathway activation drives survival; dependency on chronic active BCR/TLR signalling has motivated study of BTK inhibitors, IMiDs, and proteasome inhibitors. CNS relapse risk is not uniformly high for all ABC cases and should be assessed with clinical and site/genetic risk factors
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Diffuse effacement of nodal architecture; extranodal involvement common

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Activated B cell-like DLBCL reflects a late germinal centre/early post-germinal centre B-cell differentiation state with features of plasmablastic transition
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm  lymphoid (B-cell lineage, late germinal centre/post-germinal centre)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Post-germinal centre B-cell differentiation with plasmablastic features in some cases; typically retains B-cell markers and commonly expresses IRF4/MUM1 with activation of plasmacytic differentiation programmes
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: ABC DLBCL recapitulates post-germinal centre biology; MYD88 and CD79B mutations can converge on chronic active BCR/TLR/NF-baB signalling, especially in MCD cluster biology. IRF4/MUM1 expression reflects progression toward plasma-cell differentiation
